content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, assignment).**

**What the document says.** Section 10 (¶p0042) is the only assignment provision: a fully mutual bar on assignment, transfer or subcontracting without the other party's prior written consent, "which will not be unreasonably withheld." Section 6 (Termination) contains only a 15-day convenience right (when no SOW is outstanding) and a 15-day cure-based material breach right — no change-of-control trigger, and a document-wide search for "change of control" returned nothing.

**Why it deviates.** The clause reaches only our fallback position. Two gaps against the preferred position:
- No carve-out permitting Clear Capital to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets — meaning ordinary corporate reorganizations would require RadialSpark's consent.
- No bar on RadialSpark assigning the Agreement to one of our competitors.

This is not a walk-away issue: there is no blanket prohibition on our assignment and no Vendor change-of-control termination or re-pricing right.

**Redline (validated, ok:true).** A minimal append to the existing sentence rather than a rewrite, preserving the mutual "not unreasonably withheld" standard for all other assignments: adds our affiliate/successor carve-out, bars assignment by Contractor to a competitor of Company, and adds one confirming sentence that a change of control of Company gives Contractor no right to terminate, suspend or re-price. Since no change-of-control trigger exists, that sentence is prophylactic rather than a deletion.
